text:
nina: FYI we're getting reports that inbound leads sometimes sit unassigned >20m. SLA is 15m. saw a batch this morning where enrichment finished after owner assignment and cleared the owner field.

omar: can you drop 1-2 examples? also which enrichment provider?

nina: ids 99221, 99233. enrichment: Clearbit via hs-enrich lambda. hubspot owner property was set then became empty after enrichment update.

liz: probable race: enrichment upsert runs after owner mapping and does a full contact patch without merge rules. quick mitigation: add guard on enrichment write to never null owner if present. i'll open a small patch.

trent: temporary fallback: HS workflow -> if Owner empty after 10m -> assign to `inbound-rapid-bridge` queue (round_robin). also post to #sales-ops and create SF case. proposal snippet: ```if Owner is unknown AND lead.source="web" -> Delay 10m -> Set Owner = round_robin(inbound-rapid-bridge) -> Create Task```.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: hs-workflows/rapid-bridge v1 -> staging by @trent

omar: permanent fix items: 1) add guard to enrichment write (dont overwrite Owner), 2) add integration test where enrichment and owner-sync race, 3) emit metric lead.owner_null_after_enrich.

sales-ops: pls CC sales-leads@redwood.com when fallback triggers. want daily digest for now.

liz: patch submitted for enrichment guard. small diff: check for owner property in payload, if present skip owner key. PR #512.

ops-bot: Deploy complete: hs-workflows/rapid-bridge v1 -> production (success)

nina: quick TTA check (last 24h) before mitigation: median=19m, after workflow live (1h sample) median=7m. i'll post csv to #analytics. 95th dropped from 110m -> 30m.

omar: merging PR after CI. will add integration test simulating concurrent enrichment callback. also adding a log line: enrichment.update_skipped_owner=true/false.

liz: sending short comms to SDR channel: "If you see duplicate or missing owner after enrichment, report lead id in this thread". adding note for sales-ops digest.

trent: follow-ups: 1) add retry/backoff in owner-sync webhook on 5xx, 2) SLA alert: page on >5 leads unassigned >15m in 30m window, 3) postmortem if repeated. assigning tickets.

nina: thanks all. keep an eye and paste any stray ids here. :rocket:
